steps.name: bounded-pass-retry
steps.prompt: This is the bounded onPass retry test. Read @manual-test/counter.txt and increment the single integer inside by 1. If the file does not exist, create it with 1. Keep the file to one number only. Actually save the file.

endCondition.passRetryPrompt: The end condition is still passing, so this is a bounded pass retry. Read @manual-test/counter.txt, increment the number by 1, and save only that number.

steps.name: pass-retry-until-condition-fails
steps.prompt: This is the loop-until-failure recipe. Write exactly 3 to @manual-test/counter.txt and do not add any other text. The end condition should pass on this attempt.

endCondition.passRetryPrompt: The marker is still at 3, so the condition passed again. Increment @manual-test/counter.txt to 4 and save only that number. The next condition check should fail and onFail: continue should advance the workflow.

steps.name: confirm-pass-retry-continued
steps.prompt: Read @manual-test/counter.txt and respond with exactly: pass-retry continued after the condition failed. The expected final marker value is 4.
